limits: The close mode was never run, in the tree or in a mirror. commit() (lock, under-lock recheck, atomic replace, rollback) is untested; opt-in test cases exist (--with-close-machinery) and were NOT RUN.
The lane gates were exercised only against fixtures of Ezekiel's form. A lane that writes another form is UNMET, not skipped.
A defect test passes when its expected gate is UNMET; a planted defect often makes other gates UNMET too (recorded per test as also_unmet).

The tool trusts the --check exit and last line of gen_sidecars.py, gen_grader_models.py, _cwo_parity_dan.py and the packet generator; it does not audit those tools. The scholar checker is not run: its record is read (REPORTED).
The boss audit and both lanes are REPORTED verdicts of one model family: one voice (OW-19).
Payload building after the gates is not inside guard(): a corpus row lacking a field the payload needs stops the tool with a traceback before anything is written.
The three dan_lib data files are not pinned by the tool; dan_lib itself is, and the tiling, zone and language gates would move if they changed.
Fixtures are forms, not evidence: nothing in gate_test_result.json says anything about Daniel's real lanes, carrier entry or feeds.
